shared_decisions.decision: R7 dropped: phases are designed from the audits; unobserved behaviour is marked [assumed]

No academy-supplied script or raw HTML executes on an academy host: the public site shares its origin with /app/ and /api/ and the CSRF cookie is script-readable. Third-party integrations are validated IDs rendered from fixed templates; user-uploaded HTML/SVG is never served inline from the academy origin.

Expenses live in new app etqan.finance. Other apps post expenses only via finance.services.post_expense(source, source_id, title, type, amount_minor, currency, spent_on, notes='') — idempotent per (source, source_id) — and withdraw_expense(source, source_id); posted expenses are read-only in the API. B4 posts paid payslips with source 'payroll.payslip', type 'salaries' (PAY-013).

Online payments live in new app etqan.gateways (Stripe + PayPal, each academy's own merchant keys, Fernet-encrypted under env ETQAN_SECRETS_KEY). Other apps take online money only via gateways.services.start_checkout(purpose, ...) with a per-purpose completion handler registered by the owning app; only the provider webhook (/api/v1/gateways/webhooks/<provider>/) marks a checkout paid. Exact signature fixed by B3b's spec.
Revenue = completed payment records only (BR-47); donations are not revenue; net profit = revenue - expenses per currency per academy month (BR-48); never summed across currencies.
Group classes are one Session row per roster student (same time, linked by the group), each with its own attendance and consumption; how a teacher is paid for a group class is B4's

Subscription keeps its meaning (one student, course, teacher, package). Multi-course, family and group subscriptions are a bundle grouping several Subscriptions; billing, payroll and notifications keep reading single subscriptions
Session.kind regular|compensation|extra|trial; only regular and compensation (not compensated) consume the package; status gains at_disposal (never consumes; today's payroll rule does not pay it)
Session.pays_teacher (default true): scheduling.payroll_sessions leaves out sessions with it off; a hand-added session in an issued month is paid as a later adjustment (P7-4)
SUB-006 payment type (prepaid/postpaid) and subscription system (normal/monthly) are B3's payment metadata, not B2's

Spanish arrives in B9d (dashboard + emails). Other phases add en and ar strings only; a missing es string falls back to English per key; the ar/en key-equality test is unchanged; the public site stays ar/en in B9.

etqan.platform.uploads (B9a) offers shared upload checks: extension + content signature table, size cap, Pillow re-encode of PNG/JPEG/WEBP, tenant_upload_path. Available for reuse; no phase is required to switch to it. Private (non-public) files use STORAGES['private'] (DJANGO_S3_PRIVATE_BUCKET in production).

Supersedes D4's interface text: other apps take online money via gateways.services.start_checkout(purpose, reference_id, provider, *, user, params=None) -> StartedCheckout{id, redirect_url, amount_minor, fee_minor, currency}, after register_purpose(name, *, prepare(reference_id, user, params) -> Prepared(amount_minor, currency, description, add_fee), complete(CompletedCheckout) -> Applied(ok, reason)) in AppConfig.ready(). A verified provider event (or, for PayPal from B3c, a verified server-side capture response) completes a checkout from any state but completed; money that cannot be applied stays as applied=false 'needs attention'. Stripe in B3b, PayPal in B3c.

Archived subscriptions and sessions (B2d) are the same rows with archived_at set, hidden only from the office's default scheduling lists and Today board. Other apps never filter on archived_at: invoices, payroll, consumption, notifications and reports keep counting archived rows (BR-46 'table + archive').
shared_decisions.source: spec 2026-10-03-b2d-archives D-2 (draft, B2d branch); P1 BR-46

shared_decisions.decision: Until B4 decides group pay, today's payroll rule pays a group class once per student row (D6), since payroll_sessions is unchanged. B2f also adds an optional member_id to etqan.platform ConflictError/ValidationError (additive; the exception handler adds it to the body when set).

Refines D5: revenue = amount_minor + fee_minor of completed billing payments, with or without an invoice, grouped by Payment.currency. Payment.invoice becomes nullable and every Payment carries its own currency (B3g).

Extends D13: PayPal completes via server-side capture POST /api/v1/gateways/checkouts/<uuid>/capture/ (re-checks still-payable under a short lock; else cancels, captures nothing); PayPal refunds/reversals only set attention. Checkouts of purposes payment_link (billing) and donation_link (finance) are readable/capturable/cancellable/simulatable by anyone holding the UUID (decided by purpose; B7 registers its own purposes for anonymous access). /app/pay/return and /app/pay/simulate/$id are public routes. gateways never imports a selling app; other apps reach gateways only through gateways.services (import contract).

Confirms D10: SUB-006 payment type/subscription system live in billing.SubscriptionTerms keyed by subscription id; B2 adds no fields or hooks; a renewal starts from defaults; office-only metadata nothing reads.

Impersonation (B9b quick login): etqan.platform.permissions.impersonator_id(request) -> int|None and the DRF permission NotImpersonating. Money-moving and messaging actions (payments, checkout, payment links, chat, broadcasts) add NotImpersonating so an admin signed in as someone else cannot pay, message or broadcast as them.

Secrets at rest: etqan.platform.secrets.encrypt/decrypt (Fernet under env ETQAN_SECRETS_KEY, D4's key) is the one helper; whichever of B3b and B9b lands first builds it in etqan.platform, the other reuses it.

Self-registration (B9c) stores scheduling preferences (start date, hours/week, preferred days, intro-call time, teacher gender) on registration.Registration; B2's trial intake may read them through registration.services.preferences(registration_id). B9c books nothing itself.

Spanish (B9d): dashboard es files are a subset of en (plural-stripped keys, same placeholders), tested separately from the unchanged ar/en equality test; identity emails fall back to English when an es template is missing; other apps' language rules unchanged (notifications give an es reader the academy default). Later areas need no es file.

Every new or renewed subscription takes its default price and currency from catalogue.services.package_price(package, country=student.country): the country row while country_pricing is on and a row exists, else the package's own. Create/renew take an optional currency; an explicit price_minor is in the resolved currency and a different currency is 400 catalogue.price_currency_changed. P4-10 compares with the resolved currency. Group bundles: explicit price only when all members resolve to one currency; roster add copies the template price only on a currency match. Existing subscriptions keep their snapshot.

Cross-currency figures only via finance.services.convert_estimate(lines) -> Estimate(currency, amount_minor|None, missing, as_of): manual current rates to the academy currency, exact sum rounded once, null (never partial) when a rate is missing, always labelled an estimate next to the per-currency figures (extends B3-4).
etqan.platform.exceptions.ValidationError gains an optional code (default validation_error), additive like D15's member_id; the exception handler adds it to the body.

Learning data for B10: learning.services.progress_of(student_user_id, *, month) -> list[CourseProgress] (per course: level at the month's end, topics completed in the month, completed_total/total_topics, level changes and upgrade decisions in the month; month = calendar month in the academy's timezone). A student's level is kept per (student, course), not per subscription, so renewals/bundles/group rows keep progress; B6 needs nothing from B2f. B6 sends no notifications: B5 finders call B6's read services (each B6 slice names its own).

dashboard nav gains optional NavItem.badge (count badge, 99+ cap, 60s refresh) with NAV_BADGE_LABELS in nav.ts and a badges prop on AppSidebar/AppShell — additive shell change outside the phase markers, first used by B9c Registrations — no nav badge existed; reuse it rather than copying — cost if wrong: a small merge in AppShell/AppSidebar

Refines D13/D17: a purpose is anonymous-capable via register_purpose(name, prepare=, complete=, public=False); gateways.services.is_public_purpose(name) gates anonymous read/capture/cancel/simulate by checkout UUID. Prepared gains use_switch (default True): fee_for(..., use_switch=) — with use_switch=False the purpose's own add_fee decides at the current fee_basis_points regardless of the academy fee switch. still_payable re-runs prepare with params=RECHECK ({'recheck': True}); public routes must build params only from server-side values (never forward request data).

Extends D26 (B6b): learning.services.homework_events(*, since, until) -> list[HomeworkEvent(kind 'set'|'answered'|'completed', homework_id, student_user_id, course_id, set_by_user_id|None, at)], window [since, until) aware UTC, inside tenant_context, derived from current state (not an event log); B5 resolves parents via identity.services. learning.services.homework_of(student_user_id, *, month) -> list[HomeworkMonth(homework_id, course_id, course_name_en, course_name_ar, title, status, set_on, answered_at, completed_at)] for homework set or completed in the academy-timezone month.

Refines D17: the public return page (/app/pay/return) calls /identity/me/ only for checkouts whose purpose is not public (e.g. invoice) — anonymous link payers never hit authed endpoints; for those checkouts it renders back/retry links only after me has settled. B7's public purposes get the anonymous behaviour automatically.

Refines D24: exchange rates live in etqan.finance — one hand-entered current rate per currency against the academy default_currency, Decimal(20,10), exchanged as a fixed-point string. finance.services.convert_estimate(lines) -> Estimate(currency, amount_minor|None, missing, as_of) is the only cross-currency path; it returns None while the exchange_rates feature is off (requires=(), default off); computes exactly in decimal.localcontext(prec=60, Inexact trapped) as sum(amount_minor × rate / 10^d(cur)) × 10^d(base), quantized once ROUND_HALF_UP (away from zero); zero-amount lines skipped; any non-zero line without a usable rate → amount null and its code in missing (never partial); as_of = oldest rate used; current rates, always labelled an estimate.

requests.what: Optional, non-blocking (B3g): one line in dashboard/src/routes/_authed/scheduling.subscriptions.$subscriptionId.tsx rendering SubscriptionTermsCard exported from features/billing, once B3g merges.

B3d country-pricing hook (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-05-b3d-countries-currencies-design.md §4.2, §7, D-4..D-6; ledger D23). Additive, no model/migration. BACKEND etqan/scheduling/services/subscriptions.py: (1) create_subscription(..., currency=None): after _copy_package resolve price = catalogue.services.package_price(package, country=student.country); currency given and != price.currency -> ValidationError(field='price_minor', code='catalogue.price_currency_changed') (D25); subscription.currency = price.currency; price_minor = price.price_minor if price_minor is None else price_minor. (2) renew_subscription(..., currency=None): resolve for the old subscription's student + new package, same check; P4-10 -> old.price_minor if price.currency == old.currency else price.price_minor. (3) SubscriptionCreateInput/RenewInput gain optional currency (3 letters, upper-cased); bundle rows inherit it. (4) B2f group bundles: explicit price_minor refused 400 rows[0].price_minor unless all active members resolve to one currency; without price each member takes its resolved default; add_to_group_bundle copies template price only on a currency match. DASHBOARD: TermFields optional studentId -> prefill/currency from usePackagePrice(packageId, studentId) (@/features/catalogue), reset price when resolved currency changes, submit disabled while pending; SubscriptionForm passes watch('student') and sends currency; RenewDialog passes the student, prefills by P4-10 vs the resolved currency, sends currency; B2e conversion + B2f family/individual forms pass studentId; group form shows no price prefill and sends no price when members' currencies differ. TESTS: listed in the spec §7. EXECUTION: B2 makes it, or delegates to B3 under a claim; it needs B3d's package_price/usePackagePrice, so commits go on B3d's branches and backend+dashboard land in B3d's merge pair; rebase on whichever of B2e/B2f merges first. B3d is not queued until it is in.

escalations.question: B9c (password reset by one-time code) needs an SMS provider account (e.g. Twilio, Vonage, Unifonic for Gulf/Egypt numbers) to send codes to phones in production. Which provider, and will you supply the account/keys? Until then B9c ships with console/test SMS backends and hides the phone option in production; email codes work.
escalations.answer: Owner (2026-10-03): Twilio. Build a Twilio SMS backend behind the existing provider interface, keys read from env (e.g. TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, TWILIO_FROM), tested with mocks only; console/test backends stay for dev/CI. The phone option stays hidden in production until the keys are set; the owner supplies the account at deploy time.
